messages:
alice: Heads up — CI on main turned red on build 4829. Intermittent failure in runtime tests. Failing test: TestSchedulerRandomizedOrdering. Log shows seed drift. Putting logs below.

alice: ```
--- FAIL: TestSchedulerRandomizedOrdering (0.12s)
    scheduler_test.go:87: mismatch at step 42: expected X got Y
    rng seed: 942317
``` 

alice: Can someone queue a rerun and maybe run a seed sweep? Suspect nondet timing + backoff jitter.

ben: On it. I'll kick a rerun and try reproduce locally with the seed.

ben: command I'll run:
```bash
bazel test //eng/runtime:test_scheduler --test_arg=--seed=942317 -c dbg
```

ci-bot: Rerun requested by ben for build 4829. Job ID: job-20260318-889. Queued.

carol: If it's timing-dependent we should try enabling deterministic clocks in the test harness first. @alice did the test use time.Sleep anywhere?

alice: There's a short sleep in session_reaper.go used in test  — I added a note in the failing test.

ben: I reproduced locally with the seed. It only fails when run under -race and on macOS. Might be scheduling. Running bisect with parallelism reduced.

ben: Plan: run matrix with {race,true/false} x {parallelism 1,4,8} x {seed range 942300..942400}. I'll push results here.

carol: Good. Also add a flaky label to the PR so merges are paused. I'll add `ci:flake` to the issue and notify release.

devops: FYI, I bumped test VM kernel param to reduce timer granularity earlier; reverting now in case it's related.

ben: Found minimal reproducer: set GOMAXPROCS=1 + seed 942317 -> fail. With GOMAXPROCS>1 it passes. Weird.

alice: Thanks. I'll try removing the sleep and use a controllable fakeClock in tests. If that fixes, we'll add an eval to prevent regression.

ben: Leaving the bisect running. ETA ~20m.

ci-bot: job-20260318-889: rerun completed — still failing (1/3). Attached logs: https://ci.redwood/job-20260318-889/logs

carol: If it's 1/3 it's flaky. For now hold merges to main, staging ok. Notified @release.

alice: I'll send a small PR replacing time.Sleep with clock.Step in test harness and link here when ready.

ben: Nice. If you want I can review quickly and then we can unhold.

alice: PR up: https://redwood/repo/pull/1593 — test harness switch, reduced sleep.

carol: Reviewing now. Looks good. :thumbsup:

ben: LGTM. Unholding merges in 30m after monitoring.

alice: Thanks team. Will monitor nightly and add a regression eval.
